`unemployment_excerpt.csv` is a **genuine excerpt** of an OECD SDMX response (dataflow
`OECD.SDD.TPS,DSD_LFS@DF_IALFS_UNE_M,1.0`, G7, seasonally adjusted, 15+, monthly), fetched on a GitHub
Actions runner on 2026-11-08. Only rows for 2026-05 to 2026-09 are kept, unchanged. It is used to test
the OECD parser offline and is never published; the published copy lives under `data/raw/`.
